Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 2026-10-27

At UtilForge (accessible at https://getutilforge.com), your data privacy is our core architectural principle. All 50 developer utilities and 292 interactive calculators on our site run 100% locally inside your web browser.

1. Zero Server Uploads for Tool Inputs

When you paste JSON, CSV, SQL, JWT tokens, Regex strings, or select images for compression in any UtilForge workbench, your content is processed strictly in your device's memory using standard Web APIs (HTML5 Canvas, WebCrypto, DOMParser). We never transmit, log, or store your input data on any backend server.

2. Google AdSense & Cookies Disclosure

To keep our tools 100% free and registration-free, we use third-party advertising companies, including Google AdSense, to serve ads when you visit our website.

  • Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to our users based on their visit to our sites and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings or www.aboutads.info.

3. Local Storage

We use browser sessionStorage solely to remember UI preferences during your session (such as layout preview settings). No personal tracking profiles are created by UtilForge.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at zainmasri123@gmail.com.
